newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Arbed proposes 40 Luxfr/shr gross dividend.
newsitem.headline: Arbed proposes 40 Luxfr/shr gross dividend.

text.p: Luxembourg steel group Arbed will propose to shareholders at an AGM on June 27 to pay a gross dividend of 40 Luxembourg francs on 1996 earnings, down from 70 francs last year, the group said on Tuesday.
Some analysts had expected Arbed, which suffered a 1.2 billion franc loss in 1996, would skip its 1996 dividend as fellow Belgian steel maker Cockerill has done.

In a statement issued at a news conference confirming 1996 earnings Arbed said the first months of 1997 have been marked by a progressive recovery of the steel market, an increase in demand for steel products and a selective improvement of sales prices.
It added that a confirmation of these trends "will positively affect the Arbed group's results during the coming quarters".
